scripts.build: turbo run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database for all Envelopen data. The deploy script applies the migrations.

KV.description: KV namespace for read-mostly cache data, such as workspace settings.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for uploaded images and CSV import files.

IMPORT_WORKFLOW.description: Workflow that previews and imports CSV files in chunks, then deletes the file.

SEND_QUEUE.description: Queue that carries campaign batch pointers to the send consumer.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time token for the first-run setup screen. Use at least 32 random characters, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Base64 key (32 bytes) that encrypts provider credentials. Generate it with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

SIGNING_KEY.description: Base64 key (32 bytes) that signs tracking and unsubscribe tokens. The login session key is derived from it. Generate it with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

PBKDF2_ITERATIONS.description: PBKDF2 iterations for password hashes, at most 100000. Below 100000, the owner signs in with a passkey instead of a password.

AUTH_RATE_LIMITER.description: Durable Object that counts failed logins and setup attempts by IP and email.

CAMPAIGN_WORKFLOW.description: Workflow that takes the recipient snapshot of a campaign in pages and puts its batches on the send queue.

USAGE_METER.description: Durable Object that counts daily D1 writes and holds the flag that pauses campaigns at the Workers Free limit.

RATE_LIMITER.description: Durable Object with a token bucket per provider connection, so sends stay within the provider rate limit.

EVENT_BUFFER.description: Durable Object per workspace that collects opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and provider events, and writes them to D1 in groups.

SIGNING_KEYS_RETIRED.description: Optional. Earlier SIGNING_KEY values, comma-separated, so links in old emails keep working and suppressions keep matching after a key rotation. Do not remove a retired key.
